title: How to descale a kettle

pieces.say: Flakes in your tea? Your kettle is hiding limescale.
pieces.text: Flakes in your tea? Your kettle is hiding limescale.
pieces.label: SOUND FAMILIAR?

pieces.say: Here's the hidden fix. White vinegar, and an hour of patience.
Fill it halfway, equal parts water and white vinegar.
Boil it, switch it off, and leave it for an hour.
Pour it away and wipe out the loose scale.
Never add bleach, and keep a window open.
Clear water, and tea with no flakes.

result.say: Clear water, and tea with no flakes.
result.headline: Flake-free tea
